chapter: A Gift From Yae Publishing House
act_title: A Gift From Yae Publishing House

quests.title: A Gift From Yae Publishing House

dialogue.t: Hello there, little one. What a lovely surprise. Where have your travels taken you recently?

dialogue.sit: You tell Miko about Minnie, the Legion of Soulblazers, and the Dragonspine Cross Country Challenge.

dialogue.t: Aww. They all sound quite adorable.
It must have been quite an adventure for them, coming from far and wide, crossing national boundaries to meet with kindred spirits... Ah, it's a tale filled with the romance of youth.
The Soulblazer Saga seems to have quite a strong following. Maybe it's time to run another round of reprints...
With such a dedicated fanbase, it's only right to throw a token of gratitude their way.
How about some free comic books? Hmm... There's quite a large group of you, I'll need to make sure there's enough to go around.

dialogue.sit: I'll be sure to share them with the group.

dialogue.t: These are first-edition prints — you won't find them for sale anywhere. Take good care of them, now.
Miko gave us a pretty generous stash of comics. Since the plan is to share them with the group, why don't we display them somewhere that everyone can see?
Let's put them near the book stand at the Legion of Soulblazers' camp. That way, it'll be easy for people to browse.

dialogue.sit: You borrow a bookcase and arrange the comics from Miko on the shelves.

dialogue.t: Nice, it's looking good! Now people can come and pick some out when they're free.

quests.description: At Yae Publishing House, Miko is reading the latest works hot off the press…
